actions.name: smother
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can give it the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions, is &Reference[Suffocating]{suffocating}, and takes [[/damage average]] damage at the start of each of its turns. [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} rug can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling the target, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.
